all.source_quote: every destitute person of age 65 years & above
whose annual family income is below Rs. 21000/-
whose name is not included in the BPL List

ambiguous: Source is the Nashik district page, last updated 15.01.2019; the Nagpur district page (updated 11.09.2025) says Rs 1,500 a month, so the amounts here may be out of date
'Name not included in the BPL List' is modelled as not having a BPL card

en.title: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana
en.benefit: Monthly state pension. This 2019 page says Rs 600 (category A) or Rs 400 plus Rs 200 under IGNOAPS (category B); the 2025 Nagpur district page says Rs 1,500.
en.how_to_apply: Apply at the Collector's office, Tahsildar or Talathi.
